trans-unit.source: By enabling this feature, you consent to your data being shared with a Microsoft service that might be outside of your organization's selected geographic boundaries and might have different compliance and security standards than Microsoft Dynamics Business Central. Your privacy is important to us, and you can choose whether to share data with the service. To learn more, follow the link below.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Welcome to Shopify Connector Setup - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: We found this URL for your shop on Shopify. You can use the URL for another shop if you want.
trans-unit.target: Löysimme tämän kaupan URL-osoitteen Shopifysta. Voit halutessasi käyttää toisen kaupan URL-osoitetta.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control0 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: We found your shop on Shopify
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control0 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: The URL must refer to the internal shop location at myshopify.com. It must not be the public URL that customers use, such as myshop.com.
trans-unit.target: URL-osoitteen on viitattava sisäiseen kaupan sijaintiin osoitteessa myshopify.com. Se ei saa olla asiakkaiden käyttämä julkinen URL-osoite, kuten myshop.com.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control1 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Enter the URL for your shop on Shopify
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control1 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: When you choose Next you'll be asked to sign in to your Shopify account and request access to your Shopify shop.
trans-unit.target: Kun valitset Seuraava, sinua pyydetään kirjautumaan Shopify-tilille ja pyytämään pääsyä Shopify-kauppaan.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control2 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Indicates that the administrator user could not sign-in to Shopify.
trans-unit.target: Ilmaisee, että järjestelmänvalvoja ei ole voinut kirjautua Shopifyhin.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control ConnectionUnsuccessful - Property Caption)

(Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control ShopUrl - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: This guide can help you quickly get started with Business Central. You can import the products and customers from Shopify that you want to manage in Business Central. You can use this guide only one time
trans-unit.target: Tämän oppaan avulla voit aloittaa Business Centralin käytön nopeasti. Voit tuoda Shopifysta tuotteet ja asiakkaat, joita haluat hallita Business Centralissa. Voit käyttää tätä opasta vain kerran.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control6 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Get started with Business Central by importing data from Shopify
trans-unit.target: Aloita Business Centralin käyttö tuomalla tiedot Shopifysta
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control6 - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Import Customers From Shopify - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: You already have items in Business Central. Review the settings for your shop to ensure that your Shopify products map correctly to Business Central items, and then manually import your products.
trans-unit.target: Sinulla on jo nimikkeitä Business Centralissa. Tarkista kaupan asetukset varmistaaksesi, että Shopify-tuotteet yhdistetään oikein Business Centralin nimikkeisiin, ja tuo sitten tuotteet manuaalisesti.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control7 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Sorry, we can't import your data.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control7 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Products in Shopify are called items in Business Central. This guide can help you import your Shopify products to Business Central. You can use this guide only one time.
trans-unit.target: Shopify-tuotteet ovat nimikkeitä Business Centralissa. Tämän oppaan avulla voit tuoda Shopify-tuotteet Business Centraliin. Voit käyttää tätä opasta vain kerran.

trans-unit.source: You've chosen to import customers. Here are some important settings that define how to create them in Business Central.
trans-unit.target: Olet valinnut asiakkaiden tuonnin. Tässä on joitakin tärkeitä asetuksia, jotka määrittävät, miten ne luodaan Business Centralissa.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control10 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: You should only import customers for whom you want to track order activity in Business Central. For example, the customers that you often do business with.
trans-unit.target: Tuo vain asiakkaat, joiden tilaustoimintaa haluat seurata Business Centralissa. Tuo esimerkiksi asiakkaat, joille myyt tuotteita usein.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control11 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the customer template to use to create unknown customers. These are customers in Shopify that don't already exist in Business Central.
trans-unit.target: Määrittää asiakasmallin, jota käytetään tuntemattomien asiakkaiden luomiseen. Nämä ovat Shopify-asiakkaita, joita ei vielä ole Business Centralissa.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Customer Template Code - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Orders that you synch from Shopify can automatically become sales orders in Business Central (recommended). The item quantities on these orders are then part of inventory planning and availability in Business Central. You can also import orders to the Shopify Orders page and then turn them into sales orders manually.
trans-unit.target: Shopifysta synkronoimasi tilaukset voidaan muuttaa automaattisesti myyntitilauksiksi (suositus) Business Centralissa. Näissä tilauksissa olevat nimikemäärät kuuluvat Business Centralin varastosuunnitteluun ja -saatavuuteen. Voit myös tuoda tilaukset Shopifyn Tilaukset-sivulle ja muuttaa ne myyntitilauksiksi manuaalisesti.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control12 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Integration.Shopify)(LookupHint=Page Shpfy Connector Guide - Control Control12 - Property Caption)
